# T57

> T57 is an AI-native digital trade platform for food. Started in Madinah, Saudi Arabia, it puts verified farmers, processors, traders, buyers, banks and logistics firms on one trade record, from quote to payment. T57 does not lend, hold funds or own goods; finance, escrow and insurance come through licensed partners.

## Facts

- A Saudi initiative: started in Madinah, headquarters moving to Riyadh. A global SaaS platform, piloting in five founding markets: Saudi Arabia, UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye.
- Founder and Chairman: Afzal Hussain Mohammed Nakheeb.
- A members-only verified trade club: every member passes KYC/KYB and is labeled by role; every trade runs on one tamper-evident trade record.
- Works with the Islamic Organization for Food Security (IOFS), an OIC institution, under a 10-year memorandum of understanding signed in June 2023.
- More than 150 non-binding MoUs and letters of intent from companies in 67 countries, 120 of them signed at Gulfood 2026.
- Five industries on one trade record: agriculture and food production, trade, logistics, finance and technology.
- Contact: hello@t57.ai, +966 56 971 22 22.

## Who T57 serves

- [Governments and Regulators](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/governments): Live trade data, food-security alerts and transparent tenders, in one view for ministries and agencies.
- [Financiers and Investors](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): Every deal comes with verified parties, documents and shipment data, from deal to settlement.
- [Sellers and Exporters](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): Find buyers, agree terms and get paid, with finance and logistics on one platform.
- [Traders and Aggregators](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): Match supply and demand faster, with verified partners, live prices and finance for each deal.
- [Buyers and Importers](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): Compare verified suppliers, track every shipment and pay only when terms are met.
- [Manufacturers and Enterprises](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): Source from verified producers, see price moves early and run every contract in one place.
- [Food Processors](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): Steady raw materials from verified farms, with quality checks and finance built in.
- [Cooperatives and FPOs](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/cooperatives): Pool produce, reach bigger buyers and pay members faster, with every trade on record.
- [Partners and Collaborators](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): Development partners, associations and institutions reach the whole food chain through one platform.
- [Service Providers](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): Inspection, logistics, legal and advisory firms are matched to live trades that need them.
- [Farmers and Producers](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): Reach verified buyers directly, see market prices and get paid faster.

## Founding markets

- [Saudi Arabia: Market Overview](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/overview): Reach verified Saudi importers, retailers and hotels, and export Saudi food, with local partners for payments and customs.
- [UAE: Market Overview](https://www.t57.ai/markets/uae/overview): Trade food through the UAE with verified partners across the region.
- [India: Market Overview](https://www.t57.ai/markets/india/overview): Connect India's farmers and food makers to verified buyers at home and abroad.
- [Malaysia: Market Overview](https://www.t57.ai/markets/malaysia/overview): Take Malaysian halal food to verified buyers across the Gulf, India and ASEAN.
- [Türkiye: Market Overview](https://www.t57.ai/markets/turkiye/overview): Sell Türkiye's fruit, nuts and food products to verified buyers across the Gulf and Asia.
